One new table, identity.sealed_demo_members (member_kind organization, facility, account or patient; member_id; recorded_at; primary key on kind and id; no foreign key), with row-level security enabled and forced, one policy for its owner, no grant to any role, and a trigger that refuses updates and deletes (platform.reject_mutation). Thirteen new functions, search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp, revoked from PUBLIC: identity.sealed_demo_ids and identity.sealed_demo_facility (SQL, SECURITY DEFINER, EXECUTE for hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime because identity.patients' policy calls them), identity.sealed_demo_patient and identity.sealed_demo_account (the owner's), identity.sealed_demo_recipient (immutable: true only for operations@healthidentitydirectory.com and operations+<1-64 of a-z 0-9 . _ ->@healthidentitydirectory.com), identity.sealed_demo_contact_allowed (Identity's emergency-contact check; 42501 without a live patient session; EXECUTE for the same two roles), identity.sealed_demo_install (the seed, the owner's) and six SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions. Six new BEFORE ... FOR EACH ROW triggers: consent_grants_sealed_demo (a grant's facility or membership and its patient on the same side, else 42501 SEALED_DEMO_BOUNDARY), staff_memberships_sealed_demo (account and facility on the same side, else 42501 SEALED_DEMO_MEMBERSHIP_REFUSED), account_roles_sealed_demo (no platform role for a demo account, 42501 SEALED_DEMO_PLATFORM_ROLE_REFUSED), patient_share_invitations_sealed_demo (a demo patient invites a demo mailbox only, 22023 SHARE_INVITATION_EMAIL_INVALID; acceptance on the patient's side only, 42501 SEALED_DEMO_BOUNDARY), patient_contact_changes_sealed_demo (no phone change for a demo patient, 22023 PATIENT_CONTACT_CHANGE_INVALID) and qoreid_quota_counters_sealed_demo (no QoreID quota for a demo account, 42501 QOREID_QUOTA_PERMISSION_DENIED).
